paper.title_en: Estensioni non lineari e invarianti per dualità dell’elettrodinamica classica
paper.abstract_en: Classical electrodynamics exhibits an elegant symmetry known as electromagnetic duality invariance, which reflects the covariance of the free Maxwell equations under continuous SO(2) transformations that mix the electric and magnetic fields. However, the standard Lagrangian formulation does not natively incorporate this symmetry. Furthermore, the linear Maxwell model is limited by the issue of self-interaction energy divergences for point charges. To restore this symmetry at the level of the variational action and resolve the problem of classical divergences, non-linear extensions of electrodynamics have been formulated. These include the well-known Born-Infeld theory, which is of particular modern interest due to its connections with string theory and D-branes.This work critically analyzes and compares the main formal frameworks developed in the literature to generate non-linear Lagrangians for the electromagnetic field in a four-dimensional spacetime that intrinsically incorporate duality invariance.
